summary_en: This study tests CJRB-101, a live biotherapeutic product, given together with pembrolizumab in people with advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, or melanoma. CJRB-101 is taken by mouth as one or two capsules daily in Phase 1, and pembrolizumab is given as a 200 mg intravenous infusion once every 3 weeks; the treatment duration is not stated. The study assesses response, dose-limiting toxicities, pharmacodynamics, and effects on microbiome biomarkers, and the record does not name a primary outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba CJRB-101, un producto biológico vivo, administrado junto con pembrolizumab en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado o metastásico, carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello, o melanoma. CJRB-101 se toma por vía oral como una o dos cápsulas diarias en la Fase 1, y el pembrolizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 200 mg una vez cada 3 semanas; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio evalúa la respuesta, las toxicidades limitantes de dosis, la farmacodinamia y los efectos sobre biomarcadores del microbioma, y el registro no menciona una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give informed consent.
Advanced or metastatic NSCLC, head and neck SCC, or melanoma with at least one measurable lesion.
Untreated patients meeting PD-L1 or BRAF criteria, depending on cancer type.
Patients whose cancer progressed after at least 2 cycles of anti-PD-1 or PD-L1 therapy.
not_for: NSCLC with EGFR or ALK genomic aberrations, or nasopharyngeal cancer.
Uncontrolled or untreated brain metastasis or leptomeningeal disease.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Known HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or C under the listed limits.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
